summary: Wrote src/en/module_02/12-concepts-c.md: s10 Normalisation layers (1,256 words / target 1,100), s11 Regularisation for networks (1,363 / 1,200), s12 Losses and numerical stability (1,115 / 1,050), s13 A complete training loop (599 / 650), s14 Training dynamics and debugging (1,367 / 1,200): 5,700 concept words, all within +/-15%; then 'What goes wrong' {#wrong} with all 14 plan items as symptom, cause and fix under four ### subheadings (about 950 words). Every must_cover item, every worked example as a ::: worked box, figures fig-02-17 to fig-02-21 placed with captions, all 12 planned checks with answers, one keyidea per section. Verified in the lab environment (PyTorch 2.14.1, NumPy 2.4.6): batch-norm train/eval numbers and running statistics, the batch-of-one error, the zero-variance output, layer-norm and RMSNorm outputs (nn.LayerNorm, nn.RMSNorm), the layer-norm backward formula against autograd, batch-norm scale invariance of the gradient (1/c), dropout factors, label-smoothing targets, margin and deltas, the softmax-before-loss floors for K = 2, 10, 100, 1000, logsumexp of (1000, 999, 998) giving 0.407606, log(softmax) underflow, the BCELoss clamp (100 against 17.0), fp32/bf16/fp16 limits from finfo, fp16 exp(11) and exp(12), the variance-cancellation example, the gradient-check optimal step and error budget, the standard errors, the s13 loop (0.0069/0.992, 0.0205/0.996, 0.0056/0.996, 0.0107/0.996; seeds 0-4 give 0.9961, 0.9980, 0.9922, 0.9980, 1.0000, mean 99.69%, sd 0.30; positive fraction 40.7%; logistic regression 59.2% = majority class), and that the nn.Module form builds identical weights (1,218 parameters). Every display code block was executed and its output pasted. The checker reports no ERROR in this file.
changes: s12: sigmoid saturation in fp32 starts at z = 24 ln 2 = 16.64 (1 + e^-z rounds to 1 once e^-z < 2^-24), not 'z about 16.7'; the text gives 16.64 with the reason. The worked numbers sigma(16.6) = 0.99999988 and sigma(16.7) = 1.0 are correct as planned.
s12: underflow thresholds made precise: e^-z falls below the smallest subnormal at z about 103 (fp32) and 16.6 (fp16), but is rounded to exactly zero only from about 104 and 17.3.
s12: added bf16's smallest subnormal (9.2e-41, measured) to the format table; the plan gave none.
s12: added the measured gradient for the saturated-sigmoid example: BCELoss on sigmoid(17) gives d/dz = 0, BCEWithLogitsLoss the correct 1.0 (the plan only said 'its gradient is wrong').

s13: the plan's runtime 'about 26 s' for seed 0 does not match the lab environment: all five seeds took 31.5 s together (about 6 s each, 4 threads); the text says 'a few seconds'. Added the measured epoch-mean losses (0.0108, 0.0065, 0.0054, 0.0046) to support the last-batch-loss reading note.
s13: the source loop is unchanged in behaviour, but the nn.Sequential line is wrapped to respect the 88-column limit; the nn.Module form is nine lines rather than six for the same reason.
s14: in the float64 error-budget example, epsilon = 1e-12 is 'millions of times worse' (1e-4 against about 3e-11), not ten million.
